reason: A DSH roleplay management panel for importing character cards, worldbooks, and presets, isolating them by session, injecting relevant context and memories into chats, and providing relationship visualization and plot-option controls.

summaries.zh: 用于 DSH 角色扮演工作流的管理面板，可导入角色卡、世界书和预设，并按会话管理上下文、记忆、关系网及剧情选项。
summaries.en: A DSH roleplay workflow panel for importing character cards, worldbooks, and presets while managing session-scoped context, memories, relationship graphs, and plot options.

capabilities: imports PNG and JSON character cards, worldbooks, and presets
stores session-scoped presets, memories, relationship data, and bindings in local DSH paths
injects configured roleplay context and memory into conversations
summarizes recent conversations automatically or on demand
renders relationship graphs and interactive plot options
can insert and send selected plot options as chat messages
